name: web-seo-hologram-rising-from-laptop-screen-typing-hands
title: Glowing blue 'SEO' hologram with data icons rising from a laptop screen as hands type
whatItIs: A photo of hands typing on a laptop with a glowing blue holographic 'SEO' word and surrounding data icons (charts, gears, a magnifying glass, a location pin) projecting up from the screen, set against a softly blurred office background.
whatItMeans: Believable and futuristic; grounding the hologram in a real photographed hand gesture makes an abstract concept feel tangible.
techniques: Project a glowing holographic concept from a real device screen.
Surround the main word with small related data icons.
Keep the background softly blurred to focus on the hologram.

vocabulary.definition: A glowing digital overlay suggesting light projected from a device.
A staged photo representing an abstract business or tech idea.
